object.name: InlineQueryResultCachedAudio
object.description: Represents a link to an MP3 audio file stored on the Telegram servers. By default, this audio file will be sent by the user. Alternatively, you can use input_message_content to send a message with the specified content instead of the audio.
object.html_description: Represents a link to an MP3 audio file stored on the Telegram servers. By default, this audio file will be sent by the user. Alternatively, you can use input_message_content to send a message with the specified content instead of the audio.
object.rst_description: Represents a link to an MP3 audio file stored on the Telegram servers. By default, this audio file will be sent by the user. Alternatively, you can use *input_message_content* to send a message with the specified content instead of the audio.

annotations.name: type
annotations.description: Type of the result, must be audio
annotations.rst_description: Type of the result, must be *audio*

annotations.name: id
annotations.description: Unique identifier for this result, 1-64 bytes
annotations.rst_description: Unique identifier for this result, 1-64 bytes

annotations.html_description: A valid file identifier for the audio file
annotations.rst_description: A valid file identifier for the audio file

annotations.name: caption
